messages:
support-alex: customer Greenfield (tenant: greenfield-prod) reports that the sales dashboard embed cannot call models. UI shows models list but 'Invoke' is disabled and customer sees a 403 when trying via API. They've been blocked since ~09:12 their timezone. escalation to us please.

eng-oncall-jin: on it. any trace id or sample request from the console?

support-alex: pasted below — got this from console network tab: 
```
POST /v1/models/rembrandt-v1:generate HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer ***
Response: 403 Forbidden
{"error":{"code":403,"message":"permission denied: invoke_model","trace":"trace-0a1b2c3d"}}
```

eng-sre-maya: looks like RBAC reject. We pushed the role/attribute refactor earlier today (deploy 2024-11-03T14:05Z). Migration may have left the app-embedded service principal in a shadowed role. Can you confirm the embed service principal id?

support-alex: customer says embed uses svc-app-101 (internal id).

eng-sre-maya: checking bindings for svc-app-101...
```
$ redwood iam list-bindings --principal svc-app-101 --tenant greenfield-prod
resource:models/rembrandt-v1 -> roles/viewer
resource:models/rembrandt-v1/invoke -> roles/old-model-invoker (deprecated)
```

eng-sre-maya: aha — the refactor replaced `roles/old-model-invoker` with `roles/model-invoker` but we didn't auto-map the deprecated binding for tenant-scoped embed principals. That causes the 403.

security-liz: any KMS denies too? If the model uses a tenant-specific encryption key the principal also needs decrypt access — check key ACLs while you're at it.

eng-sre-maya: verifying KMS key acl...
```
$ redwood kms get-acl --key projects/redwood/keys/greenfield-model-key
bindings:
  - principal: serviceAccount:svc-app-101@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
    role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyViewer
  - principal: serviceAccount:model-svc@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
    role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
```

eng-sre-maya: svc-app-101 only has Viewer, not Decrypt. But in this flow the embed needs Decrypter to access cached model keys. So two problems: RBAC role name mapping AND KMS key permission gap.

product-erin: did the refactor include a migration step for deprecated roles? Should be automatic — if not, we need a hotfix + customer remediation playbook.

eng-oncall-jin: plan: 1) temporarily grant `roles/model-invoker` to svc-app-101 for greenfield-prod 2) grant KMS decrypt on greenfield-model-key 3) verify customer can invoke 4) roll forward migration script to map deprecated bindings for other tenants and add alert. I'll apply 1 & 2 with minimal blast radius.

eng-sre-maya: applying now.
```
$ redwood iam grant --principal svc-app-101 --role roles/model-invoker --resource models/rembrandt-v1 --tenant greenfield-prod
Granted -> svc-app-101 : roles/model-invoker on models/rembrandt-v1

$ redwood kms grant-key-access --key projects/redwood/keys/greenfield-model-key --principal serviceAccount:svc-app-101@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
Granted -> svc-app-101 : cryptoKeyDecrypter
```

incident-bot: deploy 2024-11-03T16:11Z - RBAC role-refactor rollout v2 completed.

support-alex: forwarded to customer. they say they can now invoke from the sales dashboard — confirmed with network trace, 200s for generate. :tada:

eng-sre-maya: verifying in prod logs for trace id from earlier: 
```
2024-11-03T16:12:07Z trace-0a1b2c3d user=svc-app-101 action=InvokeModel model=rembrandt-v1 result=200 latency=430ms
```

security-liz: good containment. post-incident actions: 1) rollback auto-migration to fail closed? No, better: write a migration that maps deprecated role bindings to new roles and runs as part of the refactor deploy. 2) add an audit alert for principals with deprecated roles. 3) run a scan for principals with Viewer+missingkms decrypt pattern.

product-erin: I'll own the migration script PR and run it against staging tenants. eng-sre, please add the alert rule and give me the query.

eng-sre-maya: noted. query: `resourceType:models AND binding.role:roles/old-model-invoker` then map to tenant scope. will add alert with 1hr sig.

support-alex: customer happy, asked for a summary e-mail. I'll send and include the mitigation steps + ETA for permanent migration.

eng-oncall-jin: thanks team. closing thread when PRs merged and alert live. :thumbsup:
